planets.name: K2-146 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-146 with a 2.64-day year, found in 2018.

text.card: K2-146 b was found in 2018 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around K2-146. Its orbit and size follow Hamann et al. 2019's fit, the archive's default.
